note: TestRFC5310HelloUsesLinkString: signHelloPDU signs a LAN and a P2P IIH that verify with iihsecret under Key ID 3 and not with areasecret under Key ID 3, and verifyFrame accepts them, so a sender using the area chain goes red. TestRFC5310HelloRefusesAreaAndDomainStrings: the IIHs signed with the area or domain string, under Key ID 3 and under their own Key IDs (1, 2), are rejected while the link-signed IIH is accepted. Recorded red on signHelloPDU and verifyFrame. The old self-consistent round trip and no-TLV-10 tags are gone.
